source_instruction: i'm looking for a toothpaste for teeth whitening in blueberry scent
query: Ugh, I stopped at the corner bodega on my walk over here and they had the cutest little keychain plushies of calico cats wearing tiny knit sweaters, I almost bought one but remembered I already have three keychains cluttering my bag. I also saw they were selling those fancy sparkling lemonades with real fruit pulp that taste like summer, but I didn’t grab one because I’m trying to cut back on extra sugary drinks lately. Oh, and the barista at the café next door remembered my order today, that made my whole morning feel so much nicer right off the bat. Anyway, can you help me find toothpaste that does teeth whitening in the blueberry flavor? I don’t wanna spend too much on it, yeah?
